n,m=map(int,input().split())
a=list(map(int,input().split()))
import bisect
subset_sums_first, subset_sums_second = [],[]
half=n//2
def compute_first_half(index, total=0):
    if index==half:
        subset_sums_first.append(total)
    else:
        compute_first_half(index+1, (total + a[index]) % m)
        compute_first_half(index+1, total)

def compute_second_half(index, total=0):
    if index==n:
        subset_sums_second.append(total)
    else:
        compute_second_half(index+1, (total + a[index]) % m)
        compute_second_half(index+1, total)

compute_first_half(0)
compute_second_half(half)

unique_first = sorted(set(subset_sums_first))
max_sum=0
for val in subset_sums_second:
    pos=bisect.bisect_left(unique_first, m - val)
    if pos > 0:
        candidate=unique_first[pos-1]+val
        if candidate>max_sum:
            max_sum=candidate
print(max_sum)
